machine: Back up this machine's setup and manage registered machines.
machine access: Read and change who may use a machine.
machine access set: Change one of a machine's access settings.
machine backup: Back up local configuration and credentials.
machine detail: Show a machine's identity, harness, sessions and token.
machine register: Register this machine with the control plane.
machine retire: Retire a machine and revoke its credential.
machine show: Show one registered machine; defaults to this one.
